root_cause.text: In xe_gem_prime_import(), when xe_dma_buf_init_obj() fails after a successful dma_buf_dynamic_attach(), the attachment is not detached, causing a dma-buf attachment leak.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states "When xe_dma_buf_init_obj() fails, the attachment from dma_buf_dynamic_attach() is not detached." The patch adds `dma_buf_detach(dma_buf, attach);` in the error path to fix this.
